name: Rocket D3
tagline: The direct descendant of the original Pick system: a MultiValue database and environment on Linux and Windows.
description: D3 is the MultiValue database that traces straight back to Pick Systems, the company founded around Dick Pick's original Pick operating system, and it still feels like Pick: a self-contained environment with its own account and file model, Pick BASIC, the ACCESS query language and nested multi-value records. It runs natively on Linux and as a virtual machine (VME) on Windows. Rocket Software took it over with the Zumasys MultiValue portfolio in 2021 and keeps it maintained: D3 10.4 is the current line, with 10.4.0.3 for Windows (September 2026) certified on Windows Server 2025. It exists to keep long-lived Pick applications running, and Rocket offers migration paths to jBASE.

pricing.notes: Per-user licensing via Rocket and MultiValue resellers; downloads require active maintenance.

strengths: Closest living implementation of the original Pick environment, so old apps run with few changes
Nested multi-value records keep header and line data in one item
Native Linux edition and Windows VME edition
Rocket provides migration tooling towards jBASE
weaknesses: Self-contained environment integrates awkwardly with modern tooling
Linux 10.3 line limited to severity-1 fixes; upgrades to 10.4 involve architectural changes
useCases: Distribution and accounting packages built on D3
Staging migrations from D3 to jBASE or SQL databases
